title: Not so good..Allot of reviews received this for free, and gave 5 stars.
text:
Not so good..Allot of reviews received this for free, and gave 5 stars.. Doesn’t work that good!
I read reviews, but now I noticed Almost All these reviews are from people that got this product free, and gave it 5 stars.
Very frustrating. for a real Buyer and user of this machine.

I also noticed, this was the only review they gave!
